text:
Soft open. The market light is YELLOW (VIX 18.7), Asia and Europe were down about 1% overnight, and Nasdaq futures are -0.5%. 4 trading days left before the Fri Oct 23 sell-by.
Yesterday's orders weren't placed, so the plan carries over. SELL ALL CRWD (below its 8% stop), SNOW and AMD (both out of the top 5 at Monday's review).
BUY the leaders from 3 sectors at about $650 each: V (#1, Financials), ABBV (#5, Healthcare), XOM (#6, Energy). -4% stops, take profit at +4%, all sold by Friday.
The engine itself only lists V as a catch-up buy today. The other two follow the deadline plan, which spreads the money across sectors.
All three report earnings after Oct 23. The Fed decision is Oct 28.
You -2.6%, system simulated -9.9%, S&P -0.6% since Sep 28.

cautions.why: Down ~16%, below its stop for 5 sessions. Sell at the open.
Extended after a strong month (RSI ~73). Use the limit and don't chase.
Last quarter reportedly cut guidance. Its next report (Oct 30) is after our exit.
